cases.requirement: Refund amounts must not exceed the original transaction value (capped at <= original_amount).
cases.source_code:
def process_customer_refund(original_amount: float, requested_refund: float) -> float:
    # FLAW: Off-by-one / inverted condition allowing refunds greater than original price
    if requested_refund >= original_amount:  # Should be >
        # Mistakenly applies refund without checking excess
        return requested_refund
    return original_amount

expected_findings.message: Business logic flaw: Refund processing allows refund amount to exceed the original charged amount.

cases.requirement: Refund amounts must not exceed the original transaction value (capped at <= original_amount).
